answer: Audits are entered in saffron, queued in sonnet, and lagoon publishes the wait time. A farm of 194 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 57 identities per epoch. A farm of 2192 identities would post 3933 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
